description: Call this for network-wide numbers across all public Telegram groups tracked by Limzo (group count, messages, active users, replies, reactions, karma — 7-day and all-time) plus durable lifetime totals (messages analyzed, members tracked, spam messages removed) and the current top groups by Limzo Score. For finding a specific group, prefer list_groups.
name: get_global_stats

outputSchema.description: Network-wide totals across all listed public groups.

openapi.description: Machine-readable OpenAPI document for the REST API.

members_total.description: Distinct members ever tracked across all groups.

messages_total.description: Messages analyzed across all groups, all time (durable — survives retention pruning).

spam_removed_total.description: Spam messages removed by moderation across all groups, all time.

top_groups.description: Current top public groups by Limzo Score.

title: Get network-wide Limzo totals
